problem:
Problem description
- There is a finite set of vehicles indexed by $$i \in \mathcal{I}$$, with $$|\mathcal{I}|=N$$.
- Each vehicle $$i$$ has a known occupied length $$\ell_i$$.
- Parking is available on two street sides indexed by $$s \in \mathcal{S}$$, with $$\mathcal{S}=\{1,2\}$$.
- The planning problem is a single-period assignment problem, so the planning horizon is $$\mathcal{T}=\{1\}$$.
- The goal is to assign every vehicle to exactly one street side so that the occupied street length is as small as possible.
- The occupied length of a side is determined by the total length of all vehicles assigned to that side.
- The street length occupied by the fleet is determined by the longer of the two side occupancies, and this overall occupied length is what must be minimized.
- Optionally, one or both street sides may have a maximum allowed occupied length $$u_s$$; if such a limit is active, the total occupied length on that side must not exceed its limit.
- The business rules require that no vehicle be split across sides and that every vehicle be parked on one side only.
- The model may include a side-specific capacity parameter to represent the case where cars on one side cannot occupy more than a specified length.
- A solution is represented by:
  - $$x_{is}$$: a binary assignment variable equal to $$1$$ if vehicle $$i$$ is parked on side $$s$$, and $$0$$ otherwise.
  - $$L_s$$: the total occupied length on side $$s$$.
  - $$Z$$: the total occupied street length to be minimized.

Input Format
{
  "N": "integer, number of vehicles, with vehicles indexed by $$i \\in \\mathcal{I}$$",
  "S": "integer, number of parking sides, typically $$S=2$$, with sides indexed by $$s \\in \\mathcal{S}$$",
  "lengths": "array of length $$N$$; entry $$\\ell_i$$ is the length of vehicle $$i$$",
  "side_capacity": "optional scalar or array of length $$S$$; entry $$u_s$$ is the maximum occupied length allowed on side $$s$$, or $$+\\infty$$ if no limit applies",
  "planning_horizon": "single-period planning set $$\\mathcal{T}=\\{1\\}$$"
}

Output Format
{
  "assignment": "binary matrix $$x$$ of shape $$N \\times S$$; $$x_{is}=1$$ means vehicle $$i$$ is assigned to side $$s$$",
  "side_occupancy": "array $$L$$ of length $$S$$; $$L_s$$ is the total occupied length on side $$s$$",
  "total_occupied_length": "scalar $$Z$$; the minimized occupied street length"
}

Example(s)

Input 1
{
  "N": 15,
  "S": 2,
  "lengths": [4, 4.5, 5, 4.1, 2.4, 5.2, 3.7, 3.5, 3.2, 4.5, 2.3, 3.3, 3.8, 4.6, 3.0],
  "side_capacity": 30
}

parameters.name: num_vehicles
parameters.description: Number of vehicles in the fleet

parameters.name: vehicle_lengths
parameters.description: Known occupied length of each vehicle

parameters.name: side_capacity
parameters.description: Maximum allowed occupied length on each street side when a capacity limit is active

variables.name: assignment
variables.description: Binary assignment of each vehicle to a street side

variables.name: side_occupancy
variables.description: Total occupied length on each street side

variables.name: total_occupied_length
variables.description: Overall occupied street length to be minimized

constraints.name: assignment_exactly_one_side
constraints.description: Each vehicle must be assigned to exactly one street side; no vehicle may be split across sides

constraints.name: side_occupancy_definition
constraints.description: The occupied length on each side is determined by the sum of vehicle lengths assigned to that side

constraints.name: overall_occupied_length_definition
constraints.description: The total occupied street length represents the larger of the side occupancies

constraints.name: side_capacity_limit
constraints.description: If a side-specific capacity is active, the occupied length on that side must not exceed its allowed limit

constraints.name: binary_assignment_domain
constraints.description: Assignment variables are binary decisions indicating whether a vehicle is parked on a given side

constraints.name: nonnegative_total_occupied_length
constraints.description: Overall occupied street length is nonnegative

objectives.name: minimize_total_occupied_length
objectives.description: Minimize the overall occupied street length, defined as the maximum of the two side occupancies

final_objective.description: Minimize the overall occupied street length, represented by the epigraph variable that upper-bounds all side occupancies.
